title: TIFR Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 02 Project Associate, Project Assistant Posts
description: The Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 02 Project Assistant and Project Associate Posts. Interested and eligibile candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their B.Sc., and M.Sc. can apply for the TIFR Notification 2026 . Interested applicants can apply in online mode.
